newsitem.title: USA: TransMontaigne buys East Chicago tank farm.
newsitem.headline: TransMontaigne buys East Chicago tank farm.

text.p: TransMontaigne Oil Co said Monday it has acquired Mobil Corp's East Chicago, Ind., refined petroleum products tank farm and storage facility for undisclosed terms.

The facility has some 1.2 million barrels of storage capacity, including specialty storage for jet fuel. It is directly connected to the NORCO pipeline system operated by the company's subsidiary, TransMontaigne Transportation Services Inc.

TransMontaigne also siad it has opened a new refined petroleum products truck terminal at South Bend, Ind. It is connected to the NORCO pipeline system and has over 200,000 barrels of storage capacity.
